text:
Noah Kim: quick check — Helix telemetry scope freeze. propose we drop multi-tenant dashboards from MVP and ship a compact telemetry surface: insights API + CSV export, opt-in for pilots. target window May 17 still. thoughts?
Sana Iqbal: can we give ACME a usable stopgap? maybe an embeddable saved-query page pointing at CSV export, so they feel supported.
Ravi Patel: technical rough estimate: backend export + basic metrics endpoint ~1w, tiny frontend iframe + auth ~1.5w, QA 0.5w. If we keep dashboards, add ~3w.
Jordan Lee: what are the measurable rollout gates if we cut? need explicit criteria to approve pilot traffic.
Noah Kim: proposed gates: 1) 48h with no P0 on pilot traffic, 2) p95 lat <250ms on insights API, 3) export error rate <0.5%, 4) retention configured to <=7d for MVP.
Sana Iqbal: I'll own customer comms. Draft subject: "Helix telemetry — pilot mode for MVP" with bullets about retention, metric subsets, and opt-in instructions for pilots (ACME included).
product-bot: created ticket INF-3301: "Helix: MVP pilot telemetry vs full dashboards"  https://redwood.internal/INF-3301 (owners: Noah, Sana, Ravi).
Ravi Patel: ops implementation detail: set feature flag `helix.telemetry_mode=pilot` and `telemetry_retention_days=7`. We can stub long-term storage to avoid infra changes.
Jordan Lee: request: add rollback condition if dataplane errors >1% during canary and automatic switch to read-only exports.
Noah Kim: agreed. Decision options: OPTION A: Pilot-mode MVP (ship May 17). OPTION B: Full dashboards (slip 3w). I vote A to keep milestones stable.
Sana Iqbal: A works if we surface limitations clearly to pilots. I'll put a prominent "pilot" badge in the UI and in the comms.
Ravi Patel: FYI we'll add a light cache flush to keep p99 sane: config `telemetry_cache=light`. Low risk.
deploy-bot: scheduled canary deployment for helix-telemetry: canary-2026-05-10 (ETA 09:00 UTC).
Jordan Lee: OK from infra side. Please add checklist in INF-3301 documenting the rollout steps and signals.
Noah Kim: final: locking Pilot-mode (A). Sana send comms by EOD Fri, Ravi open PR with the flag and retention config, Jordan add checklist to ticket. Recon Monday for post-canary review. :thumbsup:
